eventDetail.scope: IEEE ROBOTHIA 2027 unites advancements in sensing, perception, signal processing, and communication to facilitate intelligent environmental awareness, together with innovations in energy storage, management, and renewable integration for optimised robotic systems. The conference examines real-time networking, digital twins, and data fusion in dispersed cyberphysical systems through the utilisation of IoT and edge computing. The subjects encompass control algorithms, circuit design, agile locomotion, dexterous manipulation, machine learning, computer vision, predictive maintenance, human-robot collaboration, wearable assistive devices, and stringent safety, compliance, and sustainability protocols. ROBOTHIA 2027 provides an interdisciplinary platform for advancing the future of robotics and industrial automation, encompassing smart factories, agricultural drones, healthcare robots, autonomous vehicles and other related fields.
